verdict.rationale: PostHog documents its own recurring scheduling for data movement: batch exports let you schedule data exports, and CDP pipelines can send results "on a schedule". Workflows are documented with triggers and delays, but nothing shows a time-based recurring schedule (cron-like) for workflows or general jobs, or that agents can set one up. missing for 10: documented recurring/cron schedule triggers for Workflows or arbitrary jobs, schedule frequency and configuration details, agent/MCP-driven schedule creation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Batch exports give you a platform to schedule data exports to supported destinations.
